summary: Diff implements a multi-step admin verification flow in the frontend (3-step UI, session progress in sessionStorage, and updated AdminRouteGuard) and adds backend Motoko functions for step-based verification state. However, the backend diff excerpt does not show the required 'hasValidAdminSession' API nor evidence that all admin-only methods were migrated off the old shared-code authorization. Also, plaintext admin codes are embedded in backend/main.mo, which is risky relative to the secrecy requirement.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes a way for the frontend to (a) check whether the caller is fully admin-verified and (b) submit a code for the current step so the backend can validate step order server-side.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls actor.hasValidAdminSession(), but the provided backend/main.mo excerpt only shows verifyAdminCodeStep1/2/3 and does not show any hasValidAdminSession (or equivalent) method implementation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove/retire the old single-code (ADMIN_SHARED_CODE) verification/session behavior and update all admin-only backend methods to require the new full three-step verification state.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff excerpt shows the new requireAdminVerification() helper, but does not show removal of the old shared-code constants/logic nor updates to the existing admin-only methods that previously used requireAdminSharedCodeSession(caller). Because backend/main.mo is truncated, there is insufficient evidence these migrations were completed across all admin-only methods.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove/disable any remaining UI/logic implying the old single-code gate (wording updated to the new step-based process).
missing_requirements.reason: The updated gate screen still contains legacy-style wording that may imply the old flow (it explicitly says 'Enter the first verification code to begin' inside a component still named AdminSharedCodeGateScreen). While it mentions a three-step process, the requirement calls out updating/disabling remaining old-gate implications; the diff does not show a rename/removal of old-gate semantics beyond partial text changes.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a backend migration module (backend/migration.mo) and wired it into the main actor via '(with migration = Migration.run)'.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest/requirements do not request adding a migration module or running a migration hook; this is additional behavior beyond replacing the admin gate and updating authorization checks.

hallucinated_features.description: Embedded new plaintext admin verification codes directly in backend/main.mo (ADMIN_CODE_1/2/3).
hallucinated_features.reason: While codes must be validated server-side, the request emphasizes treating codes as secrets and not leaking them; it does not request committing plaintext secrets into source. This is an implementation choice not explicitly requested and increases risk of secret exposure via source access.
